description: Wavetable oscillator whose tables are spread over a sphere: turning the sphere brings different tables to the point being played, and the four nearest are morphed together

params.text: Turns the sphere about its yaw axis, -100% to 100%, bringing different wavetables to the point being played
Turns the sphere about its pitch axis, -100% to 100%, bringing different wavetables to the point being played
Turns the sphere about its roll axis, -100% to 100%, bringing different wavetables to the point being played
Attenuates the FM input before it is added to the pitch, 0 to 100%
Sets the pitch, -54 to 54 semitones from C4 at 261.63Hz
Cycles what a sync does: hard restarts the wave at every zero crossing, soft restarts it only when the phase is before the sync position, and soft reverse runs the wave backwards from there instead
Cycles how the four nearest wavetables are combined: interpolated by distance, their spectra averaged, their spectra averaged ignoring phase, or three of them used as a transfer function on the first
Sets the phase a soft sync acts before, 0 to 100% of the cycle, drawn as the gold line
Shifts which values of the four wavetables are combined in the interpolate and transfer modes, and which frequency bands are combined in the spectral modes, -64 to 64 steps
Sets how hard the output wave is folded back on itself, 1 to 4
Chooses what happens to the part of the wave past the fold: it is turned back on itself, or decimated

inputs.text: Adds to the yaw rotation, 10V covering the whole turn
Adds to the pitch-axis rotation, 10V covering the whole turn
Adds to the roll rotation, 10V covering the whole turn
Adds to the pitch at one volt per octave, and its channel count sets the polyphony of the whole oscillator
Modulates the pitch through the FM AMT knob, at a volt per octave when that knob is full; polyphonic
Adds to the FM amount, 10V covering 0 to 100%
Sets the phase the wave is read from, 0-5V covering the whole cycle
Syncs the oscillator as the SYNC TYPE button is set, acting on the upward zero crossings; patching anything here turns syncing on
Adds to the sync position, 10V covering the whole cycle
Adds to the spectrum shift, 10V covering -64 to 64 steps
Adds to the fold amount, 10V covering 1 to 4
Slides the HARMONICS drawing across the sixteen harmonics, 5V covering all sixteen
Adds an offset to every level drawn on the HARMONICS grid, 5V covering the whole range; the grid acts in the two spectral morph modes

outputs.text: The oscillator, ±5V, with as many channels as the V/Oct input

notes: the sphere is empty when the module is placed and the outputs stay at 0V; a wavetable has to be read in with Load WaveTable, Add WaveTable or Load Directory first
the harmonic grid is drawn on by dragging across it, and holding shift while dragging keeps the drag on the harmonic it started on
the harmonic grid is one display rather than one control per harmonic, so no harmonic can be clicked for a line of its own
right-clicking the harmonic grid opens that grid's own menu rather than the module's: All Maximum, All Minimum, All Half, Triangle, Sine, Ramp and Random fill it with that shape
the harmonic grid's own right-click menu also carries Flip Horizontal, Flip Vertical, Reduce By Half, Shift Up and Shift Down, which rework what is already drawn on it
menu: Load WaveTable — replaces the sphere with the tables of one Serum-style wavetable file, read as 2048 points per table
Add WaveTable — reads another wavetable file onto the sphere alongside the tables already there
Load Directory — reads every wavetable file in a folder onto the sphere
Sample Scatter — a slider, 0 to 100%, moving tables that came from the same file further apart on the sphere
